name: Append / Fetch Records Rate
description: Raw kafka_server_raft_metrics_append_records_rate / fetch_records_rate (already rate-typed JMX meters, no delta needed).
programText:
data('kafka_server_raft_metrics_append_records_rate', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-controller') and filter('service.instance.id', 'kraftcontroller-0')).publish(label='Append')
data('kafka_server_raft_metrics_fetch_records_rate', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-controller') and filter('service.instance.id', 'kraftcontroller-0')).publish(label='Fetch')
